summary: No speculative BUY is justified. Batman 2026 Annual #1 is WATCH at standard Cover A only, quantity 0. Robin Hood #1 and Christmas Darkness #1 are PASS. October 19 candidates are POST-FOC monitors, not current buys.
orderingWindow: Comic Previews lists November 2, 9, 16, 23, and 30 FOC dates; PRH confirms November 2. Exact cutoff time is retailer-specific. Confirm directly with retailer. Next listed FOC: November 9, 2026.
